correctness.rationale: For nonnegative x, the row-wise centered-ball maximal operator equals one of exactly 3^6 linear averaging matrices B_c; each is nonnegative, so its ℓ² operator norm is obtained on a nonnegative Perron eigenvector. With T_c=12B_c and F_c=1044I-5T_c^T T_c, exact leading-minor Sylvester testing proves 723 selectors have squared operator norm <29/20. The remaining six selectors form one automorphism orbit with high entries at graph distance two. For representative c=(0,1,2,1,0,2), exact characteristic polynomial λ²(λ-1)(8λ-1)(72λ²-123λ+26)/576 gives top λ=(123+sqrt7641)/144. Its eigenvector (1,a,a,a,1,a), a=(sqrt7641-73)/68>0, has strictly active chosen radii; simple top eigenvalue implies all extremizers exactly automorphic profiles with arbitrary signs. The actual verifier’s exact Bareiss/Sylvester and Faddeev–LeVerrier source was inspected, and an independent full enumeration of 729 floating-point eigenvalues reproduced exactly six exceptional selectors with λ≈1.46120009518. The global proof relies on finite exhaustive exact certificates and analytical radical equations, not the floating-point sample.
